scoringModel: Pack G starts Phase 15 with explicit task rows. Bridges from Pack G-3 onward will mark tasks complete when validators pass.

tasks.title: What-if / scenario simulation engine
tasks.objective: Build a deterministic what-if engine: given a finding and adjustable process parameters, simulate projected e-impact distribution from fitted association/statistical model. Projection only; never auto-apply anything to the process.
safetyRules: Must abstain when input is outside the observed data envelope.
Must reuse Analytics.Core or a canonical analytics contract.
Must expose backend endpoint and simulation panel.
tasks.evidenceBridge: Pack G-3 evidence bridge: deterministic what-if scenario engine validator passed and builds were green.

tasks.title: Recommendation generator with expected €-impact
tasks.objective: For each statistically-supported finding, generate recommended parameter window plus expected e-impact range, confidence and provenance; require human approval before any downstream write path.
safetyRules: Every recommendation must carry evidence, confidence and provenance.
Recommendations must be blocked under weak or insufficient evidence.
tasks.evidenceBridge: Pack G-4 evidence bridge: recommendation generator with expected e-impact validator passed and builds were green.

tasks.title: Value-realization tracking baseline vs actual
tasks.objective: Capture a pre-change baseline KPI window, measure post-change actuals versus comparable baseline window, compute realized e-savings with explicit attribution caveats, and store per-customer realized-value ledger linked to recommendation that prompted the change.
safetyRules: Baseline vs actual must be reproducible.
Changing seeded actuals must change the realized value.
Ledger entry must link to the source recommendation.
tasks.evidenceBridge: Pack G-5 evidence bridge: value-realization baseline-vs-actual validator passed and builds were green.

tasks.title: ROI / CFO value dashboard
tasks.objective: Build a buyer-facing value dashboard showing potential vs realized e-value, payback period and savings by area/finding/time, with exportable CFO-friendly evidence pack.
safetyRules: Dark and light themes must remain accessible.
Export must reconcile with ledger values.
Dashboard must explain evidence and caveats.
tasks.evidenceBridge: Pack G-6 evidence bridge: ROI/CFO value dashboard validator passed and builds were green.

tasks.title: Cross-plant & industry benchmarking
tasks.objective: Add privacy-preserving benchmarking: compare tenant KPI/finding against anonymized aggregate across other tenants and configured industry reference bands, only above minimum cohort size.
safetyRules: Only k-anonymized aggregates above minimum cohort size.
Suppress benchmarks under minimum sample size.
tasks.evidenceBridge: Pack G-7 evidence bridge: cross-plant and industry benchmarking validator passed and builds were green.

tasks.title: Recommendation honesty & approval certification
tasks.objective: Adversarial certification of the advisory layer: recommendations must never assert causation, must carry confidence, evidence and extrapolation status, and must require explicit human approval before downstream action.
tasks.evidenceBridge: Pack G-8 evidence bridge: recommendation honesty and approval certification validator passed and builds were green.

tasks.title: Phase 15 regression
tasks.objective: Run full suite including dotnet test, npm build/test/e2e where available, and certification stage after advisory/value-realization features are touched.
safetyRules: No regression in prior gate-exit tests.
Final Phase 15 scorecard bridge leaves zero below-90 tasks.
tasks.evidenceBridge: Pack G-9 evidence bridge: Phase 15 regression validator passed after all G validators and builds were green.
